text.tspan: FRAME — The left half of the reproduction is lifted out on its own.
Against it, a single continuous band of the book's own pages at
thumbnail scale runs from the three folders of page 010 panel 5
through the workstreams of page 011 and does not stop until page
072. Every thumbnail in the band keeps the provenance tab it wore
ACTION — The reader is shown what the left-hand panel produced.
CAPTION — “THE ESCALATION FROM PAGE 011 TO PAGE 072
PROCEEDS FROM THE LEFT-HAND PANEL. THE READER
